intro.heading: Born from a family story
intro.body: Café Aux Trois Licornes takes its name from the founder's three children — the idea behind it is simple: a place to slow down. Carefully made espresso, home-style dishes and board games share the room with furniture gathered piece by piece from vintage finds, chosen rather than mass-ordered.

aboutPage.heading: Our story
aboutPage.intro: A café built like a living room, born from a family story and a simple wish: to slow down.
aboutPage.metaDescription: The story of Café Aux Trois Licornes in Gatineau: a family adventure, a room furnished piece by piece with vintage finds, and a welcoming community.
aboutPage.storyBody1: Opened in June 2025 by Matthieu Maurice, Café Aux Trois Licornes takes its name from his three children — a poetic way of dedicating his very first permanent location to them. Every piece of furniture, every object was chosen with care: nothing bought in bulk, everything sourced second-hand, mismatched, alive.
aboutPage.storyBody2: The room keeps evolving: a piano, a small toy train that delights kids and adults alike, and an art wall taking shape on the 2nd floor, one piece at a time.
aboutPage.storyImageLabel: The piano corner, furnished with carefully chosen vintage finds
aboutPage.founderBody: Matthieu still greets regulars in person today, from working the counter to helping carry a stroller up the stairs.

values.title: A different pace

values.title: A place for everyone

privacyPage.heading: Privacy Policy
privacyPage.intro: This page explains what personal information we collect through this site, why, and how it is protected.
privacyPage.metaDescription: Café Aux Trois Licornes privacy policy: information collected when booking a reservation, retention, and customer rights.

sections.heading: Information we collect
sections.body: When you make an online reservation, we collect your name, email, phone number, party size, requested date and time, and any optional notes you add. No financial information is ever requested on this site.

sections.heading: How we use it
sections.body: This information is used solely to manage your reservation: confirmation, reminders, changes or cancellation. We never use it for marketing purposes and never sell it.

sections.heading: Retention and hosting
sections.body: Reservations are stored in a secure database hosted by our technology providers (Vercel and Neon), for as long as needed to manage the service and meet our accounting obligations, then deleted or anonymized.

sections.heading: Sharing with third parties
sections.body: Your information is only shared with the service providers strictly necessary to operate the site (hosting, database, transactional email delivery). None of these providers may use it for their own purposes.

sections.heading: Cookies
sections.body: This site uses only essential technical cookies (for example, to remember your language preference). No third-party advertising or tracking cookies are used at this time.

sections.heading: Your rights
sections.body: Under Quebec's Act respecting the protection of personal information in the private sector, you may request access to, correction of, or deletion of your information by writing to info@troislicornes.com.

privacyPage.disclaimer: This page is provided for informational purposes and does not constitute legal advice.
